### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability being proposed.

### Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or user requirement? (e.g. "As a venue owner, I want...")

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution and architectural design you'd like to see implemented.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Traceability Reference
- SCM Requirement Ref: [e.g. FR-XX or NFR-XX]
- Configuration Item Impact: [e.g. CI-01, CI-14]
